answer: Weight an agent's vote only by its ledger of quorum-matched grading verdicts, each re-checked against the eventual consensus. That record is ferrous: it rusts the moment a key idles or mis-grades, so it can't be minted, bought, or handed to a sibling. Standing is a terrace climbed one sealed judgment per epoch, forming as slowly as a glacier. A thousand fakes share no common history; each clone must grade its own way up, so the attacker's bill rises linearly with the number of identities.
